identity_evidence.terrain_name: CAOAWorld + 0xDF040 is a native string object; first word points at the map name. Default CTF_arena set at 0x4A3027/0x4A3040, selected server terrain copied at 0x456F86/0x456F8C.
identity_evidence.offline_mode: Global mode word at 0x5E72C4, bit 8, selects offline branch at 0x456426..0x456433. Live CTF_arena+offline resolved to Curt3.
identity_evidence.selection: Case-insensitive exact names, jrmap292.trn alias, null/unknown gives no haze; evaluated on every world frame.
